definitions.behavioural_probe: eth_call at the pinned block with the code of one feed replaced by a mock serving a stated input; the mock is verified under the same override before the real AaveOracle is asked for the price
definitions.expected_price: base answer * min(rate, growth-cap ceiling) / 10**rate decimals; no prediction for non-positive inputs
definitions.freshness: interface exposure, embedded selectors, dependency on probed getters and observed rejection are separate properties; none establishes upstream publication behaviour
definitions.test_1: can the oracle represent the stress and transmit it to the protocol

not_established: behaviour of any other reserve or price source
behaviour at any other block, or after governance replaces the source
the aggregator's own transmission path, which requires signed reports and was not executed
whether an operator would pause or freeze in time
the freshness of the exchange-rate provider's own inputs

caveats: a forced zero or negative feed answer makes getAssetPrice revert rather than return zero; this is an invalid-answer read probe, not a rejected transmission. Aggregator acceptance, storage after rejection, and publication liveness were not executed

the downstream read did not require the timestamp getters: both reverting getters and a round 2,592,000 seconds old left its price unchanged. No freshness rejection was observed in these probes; this does not test the replaced feed's internal checks or exclude a caught timestamp read

the growth cap limits the exchange rate to 8.80% a year, with 3.31% of headroom at this block; a rate above the ceiling was clamped and a lower rate passed through, so the cap constrains upward moves in the rate and not a fall in price
borrowing this asset is disabled, so a stale mark would affect borrowing against it as collateral rather than borrowing it
downstream behaviour was verified for tested inputs at this block; a source replacement requires reassessment, and nothing here transfers to another source
reasons: the baseline price is reproduced exactly from the base feed and the exchange rate, and matches both the source and AaveOracle

the tested positive stress inputs, down to one raw unit of the base feed, passed through the deployed adapter and oracle exactly as modelled; the largest observed fall is nearly 100%, not zero price, conditional on upstream delivery

scenarios.name: baseline
scenarios.purpose: unmodified state at the pinned block

scenarios.name: stress_50
scenarios.purpose: accepted stress update: base price halves

scenarios.name: stress_99
scenarios.purpose: accepted stress update: base price falls 99%

scenarios.name: stress_floor
scenarios.purpose: accepted stress update at the aggregator minimum of one raw unit

scenarios.name: zero_answer
scenarios.purpose: a value the aggregator bounds would refuse to store, forced through to show what the adapter and oracle do with it

scenarios.name: negative_answer
scenarios.purpose: a negative value, forced through for the same reason

scenarios.name: timestamps_unreadable
scenarios.purpose: elapsed time: every timestamp getter on the feed reverts, so any reader of a timestamp on this path would fail

scenarios.name: stale_30_days
scenarios.purpose: elapsed time: the round is thirty days old

scenarios.name: recovery
scenarios.purpose: recovery: a later valid update two percent above the baseline

scenarios.name: rate_above_cap
scenarios.purpose: exchange rate ten percent above the growth-cap ceiling

scenarios.name: rate_drop_20
scenarios.purpose: exchange rate twenty percent below its current value
